physical_nonoverlap_guard.scope: Every recorded exposure-matched actual visible robot mesh snapshot is checked against the conservative enclosing box of the exact cylinder reference. Positive clearance establishes nonoverlap for this static fixture snapshot, not a swept-motion or physical robot safety proof.

protocol.initial_condition: Each policy receives the same12 native inputs within a layout and starts with an independent fresh UNKNOWN map. Layouts use separately captured matched robot/fixture conditions; exact calibration, robot snapshots and all original acquired_at timestamps are retained.
protocol.policies: A_current six-policy/fixed-budget/density comparison; C,K,H fixed1024 versus edge1024.
protocol.temporal_clock: Explicit logical evaluation atmax(original acquired_at)+1ms; original inter-input timestamp spacing retained. Native publication/queue/rate are NOT_MEASURED by replay.
protocol.geometry: Exact cylinder intersections label observed depth/endpoint evidence after mapping only. Conservative enclosing box audits actual recorded visible robot meshes for static separation. No fixture truth enters selectors or integration.
protocol.offset_cycle: Explicit research-only filter validation stride1 accepts the1024 supplied off-grid pixels; no extra ray casting or production edit.
protocol.camera_count: Fixed shared1024 budget; three-camera fair remainder rotates341/342 quotas, so view count also changes revisit patterns.
protocol.timings: Descriptive measured offline CPU stages, not controlled native hardware comparisons; use the independent repeated hardware results.
protocol.scope_correction: Earlier hover datasets remain supplementary render-only stress with potential overlap; this new guarded Home dataset is primary. No old counts or failures were removed.
protocol.physical_depth_match_scope: Exact analytic cylinder intersection with15mm optical-depth matching tolerance, inherited from the V2b endpoint audit. Matching endpoint voxel counts are not a complete reconstructed surface or a collision-distance certificate.
